name: 并发与锁实验
description: 可见性、原子性、CAS、锁与任务完成通知。
commands:
$lab = 'kuma-project/kuma-project-lab'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$lab/build/lock-lab/classes" | Out-Null
$sources = Get-ChildItem "$lab/src/main/java/com/kuma/cloud/lab/lock" -Filter '*.java' | ForEach-Object FullName
javac --release 25 -encoding UTF-8 -d "$lab/build/lock-lab/classes" $sources
java -cp "$lab/build/lock-lab/classes" com.kuma.cloud.lab.lock.LockLearningDemo
expected: 全部五组并发检查通过；示例用于验证同步语义。

name: JMM 与 JVM 内存区域

javac --release 25 -encoding UTF-8 -d "$lab/build/memory-lab/classes" $sources
java -cp "$lab/build/memory-lab/classes" com.kuma.cloud.lab.memory.MemoryLearningDemo
topics: 堆 / 线程栈 / 元空间
expected: volatile 对照中 (0,0) 为零；release/acquire 发布通过。
线程局部值与直接缓冲区检查通过；普通字段不保证出现 (0,0)。
